title: Restricted Assistant Bash must run argv without a shell; only full access uses shell
answers: why does restricted bash mode split the command with shlex
Assistant bash allowlist bypass with pipes or && chaining
full access shell versus restricted argv execution in Assistant
malformed command permission denied bash assistant
body:
Invariant: In _execute_bash_on_host, shell execution is allowed only when full_access is true. In restricted mode the command is split with shlex.split and run as argv with shell=False.
Enforced at: mlflow/assistant/providers/tool_executor.py:_execute_bash_on_host, which sets run_args to the raw string only in the full_access branch and passes shell=full_access to subprocess.run.
What breaks if skipped: the allowlist checks only argv[0], so running a restricted command through a shell would let pipes, redirects or && chaining run unlisted programs. A ValueError from shlex.split must return 'Permission denied: malformed command' and must not fall back to a shell.
Constraints: Keep shlex splitting and the shell flag tied to the same full_access value when refactoring the execution call.
applies: Any change to how _execute_bash_on_host builds the command or chooses shell mode.
says: Assistant chat displays permission denied malformed command when entering complex terminal instructions.
Prevent restricted assistant command tool from executing unauthorized piped or chained shell instructions.
Allow shell pipeline and redirection syntax only when granting full access to terminal commands.
Restricted assistant rejects chained bash commands with ampersands instead of running the secondary program.
Require elevated permissions in assistant console before evaluating shell commands with pipes or redirects.
search: Assistant host bash execution in _execute_bash_on_host restricts shell execution strictly to when full_access is true, splitting commands with shlex.split and running shell=False in restricted mode. Enforced in mlflow/assistant/providers/tool_executor.py:_execute_bash_on_host and tested in tests/assistant/test_tool_executor.py:test_execute_bash_on_host_without_asyncio_subprocess_support, passing shell=full_access to subprocess.run to prevent allowlist bypasses via pipes, redirects, or && chaining. If shlex.split raises ValueError, execution returns 'Permission denied: malformed command' without falling back to a shell, keeping shlex splitting and the shell flag bound to full_access.
